thread.title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, August 3, 2018

author: admin
title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, August 3, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, August 3, 3rd, (AAPL). 12 points.
Thursday the Dow was down -7.66 (-0.03%) at 25,326.16.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.46%.
There were 13 Dow stocks up Thursday.
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Apple (AAPL) +2.92% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +1.67%.
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by DowDuPont (DWDP) -2.24% and Chevron (CVX) -1.30%.
The Jobs Report said 157,000 new jobs were created last month despite widespread complaints among businesses about a shortage of skilled labor. Although the increase fell below the 195,000 forecast, hiring in May and June was stronger than previously reported. Unemployment slipped below 4% again, to 3.9%, as more people found work. Hourly pay rose 7 cents in July to $25.07, but the 12-month rate of wage gains was unchanged at 2.7%.
European stocks are higher and Asian markets ended mostly down one-tenth of a cent at $2.873
Cisco (CSCO) reports earnings on 8/15/2018 after the market close.
